root_cause: Production Source Snapshot treated nearly every non-ignored main push as a Netlify deployment while Production Release Readback maintained a separate inline applicability classifier. The two authorities drifted, so governance-only and Supabase-only commits could start exact-source Netlify transport, browser proof and self-heal even when no Netlify-hosted runtime changed.
prevention: Use tools/site-shell/production-deployment-applicability.mjs as the single applicability authority for both Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback. Governance/control-plane and non-Netlify backend changes complete without Netlify transport; website, portal and Netlify-hosted runtime changes remain fail-closed.

evidence.failed_snapshot_reason: exact-source Netlify transport returned 401 Unauthorized three times for a CI risk-policy-only main commit
